batch4_foresight_probe_2026-08-06.setup: 3 phase-1 sil bases; 600 never-visited phase-2 probes (falling balls); scripted-intercept oracle (13% feasible); geo retrained offline 3 ways from frozen record
batch4_foresight_probe_2026-08-06.finding: geo field INVERTED on the new conduct (proximity-proxy vs time-to-intercept); collocation/symmetry do not fix it; Sigma cannot represent never-witnessed target dynamics; V-dagger carries the transferable structure -- same phenomenon as batch 3's V-dagger-based self-obs transfer

batch4b_unified_critic_2026-08-06.design: twin fields, executed-pair expectile TD anchors + HJB residual at constant 0.3 weight on collocation mix; _r0 zeroes off-manifold r-hat
batch4b_unified_critic_2026-08-06.verdict: pre-registered FAILURE: anchoring cures the inversion but the residual destroys anchor foresight; monotone in off-manifold trust (Vdag > unified > geo). Where dynamics are unwitnessed, an explicit reachability constraint with extrapolated coefficients is worse than plain neural generalization from anchors. Reshaped design (untested): trust-gated residual weight (high on-manifold, zero off) -- Vdag absorbing a residual term, not geo absorbing anchors

batch5-7_unified_critic_2026-08-06.verdict: unified critic = eps-relaxed Bellman operator; eps=0 IS the composition critic; geometry via empirical-marginal ellipsoid inside the bootstrap; consolidates ladder to V/V_exp/V-ddag(eps); geo trio retired

headline_findings: sigma-matched potential injection ignites fast then caps at ~1/3 of un-injected baseline; per-batch normalization prevents dose retirement; combos inherit the cap (swap, don't add)
headroom-gated SIL + entropy gate win batch 1 and compose; the H gate buys ignition speed (0.99M vs 1.65M ungated)
priced potential-diff self-neutralizes (intr); plain gap penalty is a self-referential doom loop; elevation >> avoidance
self-obs (tanh(Vdag-Vexp), tanh(Vdag/5) in policy obs) gives 8x faster frontier re-acquisition at no first-frontier cost; 1/8 collapse tail-risk absorbed by LP gating
LP = relu(H_old - H_now) via net snapshots: self-retiring attention field; zero collapses; expectile noise floor cancels in the difference
